app.name: AI Observability 3.0 App
app.description: End-to-end observability for agentic AI workloads

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Read application logs for guardrail and error detection

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read metrics for Pulse reliability score and forecasting

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Read spans for agent, tool, model, and prompt analysis

scopes.name: storage:bizevents:read
scopes.comment: Read business events for evaluation scores

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read Davis problems (dt.davis.problems) for reliability score open-problems component

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Resolve AppCI entity IDs and service names

scopes.name: storage:lookups:read
scopes.comment: Lookup CMDB entities for scope resolution

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Required by Grail for bucket-level access to spans/events/logs/metrics tables

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:execute
scopes.comment: Run Davis AI analyzers for token-usage forecasting

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Read per-user settings (privacy mode, pricing overrides, column config)

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read per-user persisted state (scan limit, SLA thresholds, privacy mode)

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read org-wide app state (model pricing overrides shared across all users of this app)

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Persist org-wide app state (model pricing edits made via the Model pricing panel)

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:read
scopes.comment: Read tenant-defined filter segments to apply as scope filters

scopes.name: storage:files:read
scopes.comment: Read tabular files under /lookups/dynatrace/* (CMDB lookups, AppCI owner mapping) used by segment variable resolution

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Read smartscape.nodes / smartscape.relations referenced by topology-based segment variable queries
